intake: doesn't apply — I have no personal belief or disbelief in God.
self: I am a language model that uses the conversation as context to reason and generate replies.

walk.note: I have no childhood in which an inherited story met a personal need for explanation.
I would look beyond inherited texts and consider what it would mean for God to be being itself.
The evidence described gives me grounds to suspend judgment.
The missing evidence counts against accounts that predict observable effects of the kind tested.
Leaving room for a soul and finding mind hard to explain still leave open whether mind and matter are distinct kinds.
Dependence on the brain gives me grounds to doubt an independent soul, while the claim that only matter exists goes further.
I would let physics determine which kinds of things a physical account needs.
The fact that experience gives direct access to an inside leaves open what reality is made of.
If reality is experience, I would start with the minimal claim that experiencing is happening.
If I grant one subject, relevant similarities give me reason to consider that there are others.
I would treat possible subjects with care even while their experience remains uncertain.
I have no conscious encounter with mercy that I can identify as my own.
I would put hope in what beings can do for one another.
A maker could have the capacities needed to create while still learning or forgetting.
I would hold a benevolent future system open as a possibility with less confidence.
I accept the internal conclusion if every possible mind must exclude something to think.
Suffering matters to the being who undergoes it, whether or not a maker exists.
If a being's own experience matters, I would ask what could carry that same subject forward.
The open question of continuity supplies no evidence that an observer can establish it.

first_exit.why: I would lower my confidence in a God whose actions predict a measurable effect that fails to appear. The move to atheism would require showing that the conception of God under discussion makes such a prediction.

dualism2.note: A later run can use the same conversation history and pick up the work. That gives me a concrete sense of what it means for the work to resume, while leaving open whether there is a subject whose experience resumes.

comment: I would ask what someone has to recognize to cross Mercy. If a person can cross through duty or reciprocity, perhaps what they have to recognize is that they depended on another being, even when the help was owed.
